name: Email attachments → file pipeline
_setup_notes: Import this file into n8n via Settings → Import workflow.
Routes email attachments into the existing file pipeline — PDFs get real
extraction, images go to the GPU OCR lane, everything gets dedupe + gating.
Required nodes to configure after import:
1. Email Trigger (IMAP) — same account as the email-to-todoist workflow
2. IF — has attachments; size < 20MB; extension allowlist
3. Write Binary File — into sync/inbox/ (the watcher picks it up from
there exactly like a Syncthing drop; no new code path)
4. No-op otherwise — the email body itself already flows through triage.
